# mcp-einvoicing-de

> MCP server for German electronic invoicing (ZUGFeRD 2.x, XRechnung 3.x, EN 16931)

- [Tools](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-de/tools/): full MCP tool reference
- [Changelog](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-de/changelog/): version history
- [Contributing](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-de/contributing/): dev setup and PR checklist
- [Security](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-de/security/): vulnerability disclosure policy
